page.notes: The first word is a fragment from the previous page (printed "stitia", probably the end of "iustitia"); kept as the visible letters. The small dashes at the start of several lines are printed marks, not text, and are not transcribed. The catchword "tent" completes the hyphenated word "permit-" and is kept only as the catchword.
